recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as Franz Wagner lifts the #Magic past Brooklyn to improve to 3-0 in NBA Cup action: “You’ve got to give them credit, they came out playing desperate,” Wagner said about the Nets. “It feels good though to come out with the win.” https://t.co/EwNb8KVHqy

recent.text: The #Magic got 5 offensive rebounds in the 4th quarter at Brooklyn, including one that led to a putback from Wendell Carter Jr. to tie the game late. Asked by @Josh_Cohen_NBA how key that was, Sean Sweeney made a new word: “The most key. Yeah, I think the key-est.” Full answer: https://t.co/4snEOOqljJ
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: Asked by @Josh_Cohen_NBA what he saw during Franz Wagner’s game-winning jump shot at Brooklyn, #Magic coach Sean Sweeney had this to say: “Spectacular shotmaking from a big-time player.” Sweeney later added: “… He was phenomenal tonight on both ends…” Full remarks: https://t.co/cJv2pxoIeq

recent.text: #Magic guard Desmond Bane shot 7-of-13 from 3-point range at Brooklyn on Friday night. It marked his fourth game this season hitting 6-or-more 3-pointers in 14 regular-season appearances. He made 6-or-more 3-pointers only four times in 82 regular-season appearances last year.

recent.text: We can dissect all the mistakes and frustrations later. The #Magic are still fighting for the win. Some big offensive rebounds and a big three from Desmond Bane. Someone needs to help Franz get this to the finish line. ORL 109:109 BKN 1:32 4th

recent.text: The #Nets really have no answer for Franz Wagner. The whole #Magic offense is figuring out how to give him enough space to get into the paint and let him cook. It will be the same when Paolo is added to this thing. ORL 72:63 BKN 8:44 3rd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Anthony Black with a tough finish to beat the buzzer to keep the #Magic in the lead. But that second quarter is everything the #Magic do when they struggle -- turnovers, fouls, poor rebounding. The early shooting covered up a lot of issues. #Magic lead the #Nets 62-61 at half.
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The crowd had some legitimate buzz when Moe Wagner switched onto Franz. Franz backed off to isolate and hit a floater over his brother. ORL 30:25 BKN 1:39 1st

recent.text: The #Nets essentially have four power forwards on teh floor with Nolan Traore. And somehow they still look smaller than the #Magic. Jalen Suggs with a lob from Franz beating his man backdoor. Black with a block already. ORL 5:2 BKN 10:29 1st
